top_signals.title: Flights Grounded Across US Over Air Traffic Control Problems
top_signals.summary: US authorities halted flights nationwide due to communication issues affecting air traffic control, an extraordinary action that threatens to disrupt travel across the globe. The Federal Aviation Administration said in an advisory notice on its website on Friday that the ground stop affects all US airports and departing flights should remain grounded until further notice. It cited “extraordinary circumstances” and “reasons of safety.”  Bloomberg Intelligence Global Head Aerospace, Defense & Airline Analysis reacts to the ongoing situation saying the ground stop is about de-conflicting traffic.   (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: A tanker collided with a docked river cruise ship on the Mississippi River in New Orleans, leaving the smaller vessel partly submerged and setting off a rescue operation. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: US is Struggling to Build Affordable Housing
top_signals.summary: America’s housing affordability crisis may be about more than high mortgage rates and restrictive zoning. Boston Fed Principal Economist and Policy Advisor Paul Willen says soaring construction costs are making many new housing projects financially unworkable, even after they’ve already won approval. He points to research showing construction productivity has barely improved in decades, even as productivity across much of the rest of the economy has surged. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: India's Road Fuel Demand Won't Peak Until 2034
top_signals.summary: India’s fuel demand for road transportation is nearly a decade away from peaking despite rising sales of electric two- and three-wheelers, as commercial transport and conventional fleets will keep using greater volumes of gasoline and diesel, BloombergNEF has said. India’s fuel demand for road transportation is expected to peak at above 2.5 million barrels per day (bpd) in 2034, research firm BloombergNEF said in its India Electric Vehicle Outlook 2026.
